findings.highlight: A damp magical energy that makes me want to vomit
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気がする陰湿な魔力
findings.governingReading: A nauseatingly sinister or insidious magical energy overflows into the yard.
findings.explanation: The English mistranslates moral and atmospheric malignancy as physical dampness.

findings.highlight: Sakura, pointing her hand at Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に掌を突き出している桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura is extending her palm toward Rin.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the palm to the whole hand, weakening the attack pose.

findings.highlight: I have to help them both
findings.evidenceJa: どれもが放っておけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot leave any of the three visible crises unattended.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the scene’s three threatened parties to an unspecified pair.

findings.highlight: it looks like her life is in danger
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒でも早く手当てをしなければ危うく見えた
findings.governingReading: Rin looks as though she will be in danger unless treated even one second sooner.
findings.explanation: The English omits the immediate treatment requirement and converts apparent danger into danger to her life.

findings.highlight: There’s no reply
findings.evidenceJa: 抱き上げても返事はない
findings.governingReading: Rin gives no response even when Shirou lifts her into his arms.
findings.explanation: The English omits the physical rescue action.

findings.highlight: The mud is gelatinous, but it’s just like rubber
findings.evidenceJa: 泥は液体のクセに、弾力のあるゴムそのものだった
findings.governingReading: Although liquid, the mud has exactly the elasticity of rubber.
findings.explanation: The English changes the explicit liquid state to gelatinous consistency.

findings.highlight: I panic and frantically
findings.evidenceJa: 混乱して、錯乱しそうな頭で
findings.governingReading: Shirou works with a confused mind close to derangement.
findings.explanation: The English omits that his cognition is nearly breaking down.

findings.highlight: Someone as weak as you
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩程度の技量じゃ
findings.governingReading: Sakura says someone of Shirou’s technical skill would instead be absorbed.
findings.explanation: The English changes insufficient skill into general weakness.

findings.highlight: My rage turns to ice
findings.evidenceJa: 千々に乱れていた思考が止まる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s thoughts, scattered into countless fragments, abruptly stop.
findings.explanation: The English invents rage and an ice metaphor while omitting cognitive fragmentation.

findings.highlight: But you’re confused
findings.evidenceJa: やっぱり慌ててるんですね
findings.governingReading: Sakura observes that Shirou is flustered or panicking after all.
findings.explanation: The English changes agitation into confusion.

findings.highlight: scold me now
findings.evidenceJa: わたしに口を出すコトなんてできない
findings.governingReading: Sakura says nobody can interfere with or object to her anymore.
findings.explanation: The original-PC English branch narrows all interference to scolding.

findings.highlight: A chill runs down my back
findings.evidenceJa: 背中が総毛だった
findings.governingReading: All the hair on Shirou’s back stands on end.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the bodily reaction with a generic chill.

findings.highlight: from my brain down to my waist
findings.evidenceJa: 延髄から尾底骨まで
findings.governingReading: The freezing knife-like sensation runs from the medulla oblongata to the coccyx.
findings.explanation: The English changes both anatomical endpoints.

findings.highlight: The thing that went around town killing people like a [r]machine[line4]is Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 機械が行う作業のように街の人間を殺してまわったものが桜、だった
findings.governingReading: The entity that killed townspeople without emotion, like a machine performing a task, was Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English runs “machine” and “is” together and weakens the task comparison.

findings.highlight: trying to defrost my frozen body
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に、怖れで凍りついた体を解凍しようと努力する
findings.governingReading: Every cell desperately attempts to thaw the body frozen by fear.
findings.explanation: The English omits the desperate effort.

findings.highlight: Sakura is being hostile towards me
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は本気で俺に、殺意を向けていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura is seriously directing killing intent at Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an immediate will to kill to generic hostility.

findings.highlight: you’d watch over everyone but me
findings.evidenceJa: わたしだけを見てくれなかった
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Shirou would not look exclusively at her.
findings.explanation: The English changes divided attention into total neglect of Sakura while he protects everyone else.

findings.highlight: It tells me it’s not her. She’s not Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 違う、と。 アレは桜ではないと
findings.governingReading: The forbidden thought in Shirou insists: no, that thing is not Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English invents an “it” speaking the denial to him.

findings.highlight: I had to get away from you
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩の前から消えないといけなかった
findings.governingReading: Sakura believed she had to disappear from Shirou’s presence.
findings.explanation: The English weakens self-erasure into leaving him.

findings.highlight: a stage for a shadow picture
findings.evidenceJa: 影絵の舞台
findings.governingReading: The courtyard resembles a stage for shadow play.
findings.explanation: The English uses the nonidiomatic and static “shadow picture.”

findings.highlight: I react by instinct
findings.evidenceJa: ボロボロの思考のまま
findings.governingReading: Shirou acts while his thoughts remain in tatters.
findings.explanation: The English invents instinct and omits his damaged cognition.

findings.highlight: pushing Tohsaka away
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂を弾き飛ばした
findings.governingReading: Shirou knocks or flings Rin clear of the attack.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the force and distance to a push.

findings.highlight: The black tide sweeps over me
findings.evidenceJa: 頭上から黒い波が落ちる
findings.governingReading: The black wave falls from overhead.
findings.explanation: The English changes the attack’s vertical trajectory to a horizontal sweep.

findings.highlight: That knowledge wouldn’t let me move my body
findings.evidenceJa: その事実が、体に避ける事を命じなかった
findings.governingReading: Because of his guilt at denying Sakura, the fact does not command his body to evade.
findings.explanation: The English turns a failure of self-preserving bodily command into knowledge physically immobilizing him.

findings.highlight: if it falls directly on me
findings.evidenceJa: 真っ白のまま浴びたのなら
findings.governingReading: If Shirou receives the darkness while his mind remains completely blank, his mind will vanish before his body.
findings.explanation: The English changes the vulnerable mental state into direct physical exposure.

findings.highlight: My warmth fades away
findings.evidenceJa: 体温がまたたくまにゼロになっていく
findings.governingReading: His body temperature rapidly falls toward zero.
findings.explanation: The English omits both speed and the zero endpoint.

findings.highlight: just breathing is enough effort to render me unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 息を吸うたびに意識が落ちかける
findings.governingReading: Even while kneeling, Shirou nearly loses consciousness with every breath.
findings.explanation: The English promotes repeated near-blackouts into breathing rendering him unconscious and adds effort as the cause.

findings.highlight: Maybe she’s serious because Rider is opposing her
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの裏切りで本気になったのか
findings.governingReading: The narration wonders whether Rider’s betrayal made Sakura turn serious.
findings.explanation: The English weakens betrayal to opposition, reducing the weight of Rider obeying Sakura’s earlier order against her present wish.

findings.highlight: it’ll be meaningless
findings.evidenceJa: 今のサクラには意味がない
findings.governingReading: Those retaliatory acts have no purpose for Sakura in her present state.
findings.explanation: The English omits the time-bounded qualification.

findings.highlight: why don’t you stop throwing a tantrum
findings.evidenceJa: 八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら
findings.governingReading: Illya tells Sakura to stop taking her anger out on unrelated targets.
findings.explanation: The English infantilizes displaced retaliation as a tantrum and loses the victim relation.

findings.highlight: I’ll go with you
findings.evidenceJa: 大人しく一緒にいってあげる
findings.governingReading: Illya offers to go along quietly and without resistance.
findings.explanation: The English omits the manner that makes her bargain credible.

findings.highlight: Illya talks without emotion
findings.evidenceJa: 淡々とイリヤは語る
findings.governingReading: Illya speaks evenly and matter-of-factly.
findings.explanation: The English overstates controlled delivery as absence of emotion.

findings.highlight: I can’t figure out
findings.evidenceJa: 意識を総動員しても
findings.governingReading: Even mobilizing all his consciousness, Shirou cannot read Illya’s intent.
findings.explanation: The English omits the extreme cognitive effort imposed by his condition.

findings.highlight: now you do want to kill them
findings.evidenceJa: みんなを殺したくて仕方がない
findings.governingReading: Illya says Sakura now cannot help wanting to kill everyone.
findings.explanation: The English removes both compulsion and universal scope.

findings.highlight: I’ll fall for your smooth talk
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女の口車に乗ってあげます
findings.governingReading: Sakura knowingly agrees to play along with Illya’s persuasive line.
findings.explanation: The English makes her a dupe who falls for it, reversing deliberate agency.

findings.highlight: I scream for her to stop
findings.evidenceJa: 膝をついたまま、遠ざかっていく桜を呼び止める
findings.governingReading: Still on his knees, Shirou calls after the receding Sakura to stop her.
findings.explanation: The English omits his kneeling incapacity and adds a scream.

findings.highlight: Should you stand in my way again
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩を前にしたら
findings.governingReading: Sakura says that if she is faced with Shirou, she has no choice but to kill him.
findings.explanation: The English adds that Shirou must obstruct her, narrowing the danger to deliberate interference.

findings.highlight: Sakura leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が遠くなっていく
findings.governingReading: Sakura recedes farther and farther from Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English removes the gradual visual and emotional distancing.

findings.highlight: unable even to take Sakura’s hand
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の手も引っ張れなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou condemns himself for failing to grab and pull Sakura away by the hand.
findings.explanation: The English weakens rescue through pulling into merely taking her hand.

findings.highlight: my brain churns with cold nausea
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気と悪寒で脳みそがぐるんぐるん
findings.governingReading: Nausea and chills make Shirou’s brain spin.
findings.explanation: The English conflates two symptoms into the unnatural phrase “cold nausea.”

findings.highlight: She points her sword at me, overwhelming us without saying a word
findings.evidenceJa: 終始無言だった彼女は剣を突きつけ
findings.governingReading: Saber, who had remained silent throughout the preceding confrontation, now speaks and points her sword.
findings.explanation: Placed after her spoken warning, the English claims she performs the current action silently and creates a contradiction.

findings.highlight: as if they’ve faded into the shadow
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の影に沈むように
findings.governingReading: The two girls vanish as though sinking into Sakura’s shadow.
findings.explanation: The English changes sinking to fading and removes Sakura’s ownership of the shadow.

findings.highlight: My body drops to the ground like a puppet with its strings cut
findings.evidenceJa: 手足は、糸の切れた人形のように地面に落ちる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s arms and legs fall to the ground like a cut-string puppet as his driving will breaks.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the limb-specific collapse to his whole body.

findings.highlight: “Da”
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins a broken “damn” or curse as his strength fails.
findings.explanation: The English supplies an unrelated syllable that does not connect to the following fragment.

findings.highlight: sticks in my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 目蓋に焼き付いて離れなかった
findings.governingReading: The image burns itself onto Shirou’s eyelids and will not leave.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the bodily afterimage with generic memory.
